name: anti-silencing function 1B histone chaperone

function.text: ASF1B is the approved symbol for anti-silencing function 1B histone chaperone. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in histone binding; histone chaperone activity; DNA replication-dependent chromatin assembly.

function.text: ASF1B encodes anti-silencing function 1B histone chaperone. It is a histone chaperone that facilitates histone deposition and histone exchange and removal during nucleosome assembly and disassembly. It cooperates with chromatin assembly factor 1 (CAF-1) to promote replication-dependent chromatin assembly. It is also involved in the nuclear import of the histone H3-H4 dimer together with importin-4 (IPO4): specifically recognizes and binds newly synthesized histones with the monomethylation of H3 'Lys-9' (H3K9me1) and diacetylation at 'Lys-5' and 'Lys-12' of H4 (H4K5K12ac) marks in the cytosol.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ASF1B have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.
